core_obligations: Choose a maximal modification (proof lines 2100-2108): among normal modifications of the spectrum of the ring pick one maximizing the length of the first cohomology of its structure sheaf; for any further normal modification the first direct image of the structure sheaf vanishes and the first cohomology groups agree by the exact sequence.

Show each local ring is rational (proof lines 2110-2126): for a closed point of the chosen modification and a normal modification of its local ring, spread that modification to a modification of the ambient scheme which is an isomorphism away from the point; normality is inherited because both the ambient scheme and the given modification are normal, and maximality makes the first direct image of the structure sheaf vanish, which by the exact sequence means that the first cohomology of the modification of the local ring vanishes, i.e. the local ring defines a rational singularity.

Conclude projectivity and rationality along the sequence (proof lines 2128-2134): choose a sequence of normalized blowups dominating the maximal modification; for a closed point of the last term mapping to a closed point of the maximal modification, the propagation lemma applied to the local extension shows that the local ring at that point again defines a rational singularity; the resulting sequence is a modification with normal projective terms as required.
proof_roadmap: Select a normal modification maximizing the length of the first cohomology.
Spread modifications of the local rings at closed points to the ambient scheme and use maximality to prove rationality of those local rings.
Dominate the maximal modification by normalized blowups and propagate rationality to the points above.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if reduction to rational singularities is possible for a two dimensional local normal Nagata domain, then there is a finite sequence of normalized blowups in closed points whose last term has every closed point defining a rational singularity, and which is in particular a normal projective modification (statement lines 2086-2098). The proof (proof lines 2100-2136) chooses a modification maximizing the length of the first cohomology, spreads modifications of the local rings at closed points to the ambient scheme to prove rationality there by maximality, and dominates the maximal modification by normalized blowups, propagating rationality along the local extensions. H3: a maximality argument with a spreading step, written out in full.
